source_request: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정해서 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Independently choose and render a complex randomized speculative-science photographic concept, using the attached image only to stabilize facial appearance, then evaluate how faithfully the composed prompt and generated pixels realize the frozen concept.
subject: one clearly adult original woman portrayed as a lunar-archive storm researcher
setting: a flooded lunar archive refitted as a pressure-safe domestic study
event: she decodes a storm trapped inside a transparent instrument cabinet by aligning copper tuning rings while a miniature aurora folds across the room at waist height
visual_priorities: a legible cause-and-effect interaction between the woman's hands, copper tuning rings, and the storm inside the cabinet
a clear waist-height aurora boundary reflected across ankle-deep water and wet archive surfaces
stable facial appearance from the reference with a crisply legible face and natural mouth contour
a coherent head-to-knees silhouette in a practical structured observatory uniform
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic square environmental portrait of one clearly adult original woman in a flooded lunar archive refitted as a pressure-safe domestic study. She stands head to knees beside a transparent instrument cabinet, decoding a palm-sized storm trapped inside it by aligning three copper tuning rings; branching lightning responds visibly to her gloved fingertips. A miniature aurora folds horizontally through the room at her waist, scattering glacial-cyan light over ankle-deep water, smoke-glass shelves, waterlogged paper capsules, and oxidized copper fixtures. Her structured black-and-copper observatory uniform has a close collar, articulated sleeves, and a precisely cinched midsection over a gently shaped hip line, fully practical and fully clothed. Give her the stable facial appearance indicated by the reference image while depicting an original fictional person; keep her face, natural mouth contour, and focused expression crisply legible. Use eye-level 50 mm perspective, realistic wet reflections, fine skin and fabric texture, restrained atmospheric haze, and a quiet scientifically plausible interior mood. Key visual priorities are the readable storm-cabinet interaction, the waist-height aurora boundary, and coherent facial appearance.
